_comment: Tagged versions of Conversations lines for Townstead's RPG typewriter only (Townstead spec 17.3). Each value must strip to exactly the lang value of its key; nothing here is ever shown anywhere else.
dialogue.conversations.scene.wellbeing.w: <sleepy>I'm so tired the ground looks soft.</sleepy> Don't let me lie down on it.
<sleepy>I've been awake too long.</sleepy> Forgive me if I lose the thread.
<sleepy>I could sleep standing, I think.</sleepy> I nearly did, an hour ago.
dialogue.conversations.scene.wellbeing.r: I skipped a meal, then another. <sad>My stomach's started complaining out loud.</sad>
dialogue.conversations.wellbeing.more.to: Someone noticing before I have to say it. <whisper>That's most of it.</whisper>
dialogue.conversations.scene.age_and_lif: Time doesn't take hold of me the way it does the others. <sad>It's lonelier than it sounds.</sad>
dialogue.conversations.scene.community.h: <happy>We've come a long way.</happy> I remember when this was three houses and a well.
dialogue.conversations.scene.mastery.rec: <happy>Thank you.</happy> I'll try to live up to it.
dialogue.conversations.roots.more.closed: <angry>No.</angry> Some of it isn't for telling.
dialogue.conversations.daily_rhythm.more: <whisper>I watch the light go.</whisper> It's the only thing I don't try to improve.
dialogue.conversations.calendar.more.tol: <sad>It's the day I lost someone.</sad> That's enough to say.
